headline: Third reading of Ends Policy update and revised Executive Limitation 2.4 on financial condition, plus Frederick H. Tuttle Middle School student presentation.
summary: The meeting covers third readings of an Ends Policy update and a revised financial condition limit. It also includes choosing members to vote at two annual meetings and naming a member to the Act 170 Merger Committee.
items: Closed executive session on employment, attorney-client communication, labor negotiations, and real estate
Frederick H. Tuttle Middle School student presentation
Monthly 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities review
Revised Executive Limitation 2.4 Financial Condition and Activities, third reading
Designate member to vote at VSBIT Annual Meeting
Designate member to vote at VSBA Annual Meeting
Designate third member for Act 170 Merger Committee
Superintendent's report on cell phone policy compliance
Set agenda for October 7, 2026 regular meeting
Review future agenda items and parking lot
